fine_lines.title: find vs found
fine_lines.explanation_ar: find فعل شاذ: المضارع find والماضي found. نقول: I found it! (وجدته) ولكن في السؤال والنفي نعود للأصل: Did you find it? / I didn't find it.
fine_lines.explanation_en: find is irregular: present find, past found. We say I found it! But in past questions and negatives use the base form: Did you find it? / I didn't find it.

examples.sentence: Did you find the bald eagle?

fine_lines.title: should vs ought to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان لإعطاء النصيحة لنفسك أو لغيرك وبالمعنى نفسه تقريبًا. Anna تقول: I should be more careful ثم I ought to be more careful.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both give advice, to yourself or others, with almost the same meaning. Anna says 'I should be more careful' and later 'I ought to be more careful.'

examples.sentence: I ought to be more careful.

grammar.title: Simple past: irregular verbs
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) بعض الأفعال لا تأخذ -ed في الماضي ولها شكل خاص يجب حفظه. 2) من الدرس: find → found, win → won, say → said, fly → flew, see → saw. 3) الشكل نفسه مع كل الضمائر: I found, she found.
grammar.explanation_en: 1) Some verbs do not take -ed in the past; they have a special form you must learn. 2) From the lesson: find → found, win → won, say → said, fly → flew, see → saw. 3) The form is the same for all subjects.
examples: Dan said the game is fun.

grammar.title: Past questions and short answers with did
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) سؤال الماضي: Did + الفاعل + الفعل الأصلي: Did you find the bald eagle? 2) لا نستخدم الماضي بعد did: (Did you found خطأ). 3) الإجابة القصيرة: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. 4) ويمكن أن نسأل نفس السؤال للشخص الآخر: No. Did you?
grammar.explanation_en: 1) Past question: Did + subject + base verb: Did you find the bald eagle? 2) Don't use the past form after did (not 'Did you found'). 3) Short answers: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. 4) You can ask back: No. Did you?
examples: Did you find any symbols? — Yes, I did.
Did you find the bald eagle? — No. Did you?
Did Lincoln want freedom? — Yes, he did.
